Pulse Labs delivers actionable, human-centered insights that guide the product lifecycles of the world’s leading technology companies. Backed by investors including Google, we provide end-to-end user research – from early concept to post-launch – powering high-priority innovations across AI, mobile platforms, wearables, and connected ecosystems.
 We are seeking a Senior Mixed-Methods Researcher to lead high-impact research initiatives and serve as a strategic partner to our clients. In this role, you will architect and execute comprehensive quantitative and qualitative studies, including surveys, longitudinal panels, diary studies, usability testing, IDIs, as well as statistical analysis. Leveraging Pulse Labs’ proprietary research platform, you will synthesize rich video and survey datasets to deliver clear, data-driven narratives about how users interact with next-generation products.
 You will join a collaborative team of researchers and analysts operating in a fast-paced, rapid-delivery environment where methodological rigor is paramount. If you excel at balancing multiple high-visibility projects, solving complex research challenges, and influencing cutting-edge tech, we would love to connect.
 This is a 100% full-time remote requiring at least 80% overlap with Pacific Time (UTC/GMC-8). At times, you will be required to work before and after standard work hours, including weekends, to ensure quality and on-time client delivery.
 Key Responsibilities
 Client Consultation & Research Strategy: Partner directly with enterprise clients to scope, design, and align research plans with business goals, technical requirements, and delivery timelines.
 Mixed-Methods Execution: Architect and lead end-to-end research using advanced survey design, UX methodologies, and questionnaire frameworks, maintaining high standards of data integrity and client satisfaction.
 Research Study Project Ownership: Own the planning, execution, and delivery of fast-paced, multi-track research studies. Act as the central driver of project success collaborating closely with Program Management, Recruitment, and Ops to monitor project health, safeguard data quality, enforce timelines, and maintain methodological rigor throughout.
 Qualitative Synthesis: Mine rich multimodal data, including participant video recordings, transcripts, and open-ended feedback, to uncover behavioral drivers and product opportunities.
 Quantitative Analysis: Run advanced statistical analyses (e.g., MaxDiff, conjoint analysis, factor analysis) to evaluate feature prioritization, trade-offs, and behavioral trends.
 Deliverable Creation & Storytelling: Translate complex data into compelling, client-ready formats, including executive summaries, scorecards, slide decks, and detailed analytical reports tailored to stakeholder needs.
 Stakeholder Presentation: Present findings and strategic recommendations to cross-functional teams and executive leadership across various technology verticals.
 Mentorship & Culture: Coach and mentor junior researchers and analysts, fostering analytical consistency and professional growth across the team.
 Continuous Improvement: Partner with internal leadership to refine research workflows, streamline operational processes, and integrate lessons learned from project cycles.
 Must be fluent in English
 Experience: 5+ years of mixed-methods research experience leading end-to-end quantitative and qualitative investigations in a fast-paced, detail-oriented research operations environment.
 Methodological Depth: Proven expertise across the entire research lifecycle – from study design and advanced data collection to analysis and synthesis – with deep familiarity with UX, behavioral, and human-centered design frameworks.
 Client & Stakeholder Management: Track record of managing client/consulting relationships, with demonstrated success translating complex findings and presenting both original and peer-conducted research to senior and executive stakeholders.
 Analytical & Data Acumen: Strong pattern recognition and anomaly detection skills, capable of identifying subtle behavioral trends and ensuring data integrity across large, multimodal datasets.
 Operational Drive & Autonomy: High degree of personal ownership, proactivity, and operational rigor; comfortable navigating ambiguity and self-initiating solutions in a rapid-response, multi-project setting.
 Cross-Functional Collaboration: Proven ability to partner effectively with internal teams, external stakeholders, and clients, maintaining a positive and highly collaborative team environment.
 Tools & Software: Tech-forward mindset with advanced proficiency in Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Slides) and adaptability with modern analytical, panel management, and proprietary SaaS platforms.
 Education: Graduate degree in Psychology, Survey Methodology, HCI, Human Factors, Research Methods, or a closely related field.
 Preferences: Prior experience in an agency, consultancy, or vendor-side research environment delivering client-facing insights; experience conducting research for or working within FAANG/tier-one tech companies; hands-on familiarity with next-gen consumer technologies, hardware, or AI-driven product ecosystems.

 About us
 Claio is a Montréal-based AI platform built for dental and healthcare practices. More than 400 practices across North America use Claio to answer patient calls, fill their schedules, and cut time spent on clinical notes. Clinicians report saving an average of 8+ hours a week on documentation.
 Our solutions: 
 AI Front Desk: answers patient calls 24/7, including nights and weekends. It books and reschedules appointments directly in the practice management system and hands calls to staff when needed.
 AI Scribe: turns patient conversations into structured clinical notes in the practice’s own templates and sends them straight to the practice management system. It can transcribe dozens of languages and then create notes in English, French, and Spanish.
 Our ecosystem: Claio plugs into the tools practices already use, with integrations into 17+ practice management systems, including Dentrix, Open Dental, Eaglesoft, MacPractice, and Dentitek. Claio was developed within the Manos Software Group and is backed by Valsoft Corporation, a Canadian company that builds and acquires vertical market software. That backing gives our agents a stable, growing product and a broader healthcare software portfolio behind them.
 We’re building a network of independent agents to grow our presence in Saskatchewan and Manitoba.
 The role
 You’ll represent our product line to dental practices, DSOs, and labs in your territory, alongside other complementary, non-competing lines you already carry. You run your own business and set your own schedule.
 We provide product training, samples, marketing materials, and lead support.
 What you’ll do
 Introduce and sell our products to general dentists, specialists, DSOs, and labs.
 Build on your existing relationships and open new accounts through office visits, demos, and lunch-and-learns.
 Represent us at study clubs, regional dental meetings, and trade shows.
 Share monthly activity and pipeline updates, and pass along market feedback.
 Not just dental: Claio also serves medical practices, so you’re free to reach out to clinics in every medical specialty, from family medicine to specialist practices.
 5+ years of dental sales experience, as an independent agent or with a manufacturer or distributor.
 An active network of dental offices in Saskatchewan and Manitoba. The territory is exclusive to you among independent agents, though Claio’s in-house reps may also sell there.
 A current portfolio of complementary lines (please list them so we can confirm there’s no conflict).
 Strong product-demo and presentation skills, and comfort with technical or clinical conversations.
 Reliable transportation and willingness to travel within the territory.
 Commission: Competitive commission rate on new bookings, paid quarterly and uncapped.
 Optional extras: An ongoing percentage bonus on subscription renewals and reorders from the accounts you sign.
 Support: product training, demo samples, marketing materials, and leads from our website / trade shows / distributor partners.
 Expenses: Claio provides demo accounts, marketing materials, and product training, and covers booth fees for Saskatchewan and Manitoba dental events we ask you to attend (e.g. the Saskatchewan Dental Conference or the Manitoba Dental Association Annual Convention).  An overview of this role 
 We are hiring a Staff Product Security Architect to join our Security Platforms and Architecture organization at GitLab.
 Rather than operating as a purely consultative body, Security Architecture at GitLab functions as a hands-on technical driver. Our mission is to embed proactive guidance directly into modern developer workflows and automated coding environments, embedding security standards into the software development process from the outset. We strive to enable teams to deliver secure, resilient software seamlessly while minimizing reliance on manual security gates.
 In this role, you will collaborate closely with product engineering organizations, spearhead architectural strategy for critical capabilities, and serve as the primary Security Owner driving risk reduction for key entries within our risk management framework. Your daily work will span architectural design reviews, technical prototyping, and establishing scalable patterns that enable engineering teams to execute autonomously.
 What you’ll do 
 Partner with engineering and product leadership across GitLab, developing enough context in their domains to anticipate security problems rather than react to them
 Lead security architecture and design work for strategic initiatives, and provide direction to the cross-functional teams delivering them
 Identify, assess, and prioritise systemic security risks, and act as Security Owner for high-priority items in the Product Security Risk Register, co-executing remediation with the teams who own the code
 Codify recurring security decisions into reusable artifacts — guardrails, standards, design patterns,skills, and reference threat models — delivered into developer and AI coding tool workflows
 Build proofs of concept and prototypes to unblock engineering teams and shorten the distance between a security requirement and a working implementation
 Conduct security architecture reviews for large or strategic projects, and coordinate with Application Security so that review coverage is comprehensive and correctly prioritised
 Threat model new and existing systems, and establish the patterns that let teams threat model their own work
 Work with Security Research on proactive exploration of unknown risks in GitLab's architecture
 Anticipate emerging security challenges and propose architectural responses before they reach implementation
 Mentor security engineers across the division, and represent security architecture to engineering audiences
 What you’ll bring 
 Depth in application security architecture, including authentication and authorization models, privilege escalation, multi-tenant isolation, and trust boundary analysis
 Experience securing distributed systems, including service-to-service authentication, secrets handling, and the failure modes of security decisions made across process boundaries
 Working knowledge of software supply chain security: build and release integrity, artifact provenance, and dependency risk
 A track record of proactive architecture work — identifying risk before it becomes an incident, and designing something that prevents a class of problem rather than an instance of one
 Demonstrated ability to build trusted relationships with engineering leadership and influence technical direction through expertise rather than gatekeeping
 Experience defining security standards or patterns that teams adopted without being compelled to
 The ability to operate strategically while remaining hands-on, including reading unfamiliar code, building prototypes, and contributing changes
 Clear written communication, and the ability to make a security argument to an engineering audience that does not already agree with it
 A view on how security guidance should be authored and delivered for AI coding tools, not only for humans

 About The Role:  
 Join Edelweiss Group as our Junior HR & Systems Specialist, a role supporting HR across the Group as a whole. You will act as the primary owner and point of contact for our HRIS, while providing hands-on support for HR integrations as new businesses join the Group — from HRIS onboarding of new entities to policy rollout — and serving as a day-to-day generalist resource wherever the Group needs it. You'll also help identify and build simple automations, including AI-assisted ones, that make integrations and everyday HR administration faster and less manual. Because the Group's mix of entities, jurisdictions, and priorities is always shifting, this role calls for someone genuinely curious and comfortable adapting to an ever-changing environment, rather than someone looking for a fixed, narrowly scoped routine. 
 The successful candidate will be based in Montreal and will work at our office in Saint-Laurent. 
 What You'll Be Doing:  
 HRIS Integrations Support  
 Support the Group HR Lead in integrating newly acquired businesses into Edelweiss Group’s systems including uploading and maintaining accuracy of employee information on HRIS, ensuring data integrity during integrations across employee profiles, files, and documentation. 
 Facilitate live learning sessions centered around training of new and existing systems for newly integrated teams. 
 System Support & AI Automation  
 Own and maintain a deep working knowledge of the HRIS platform's capabilities, features, structure, system upkeep, and workflow logic to troubleshoot issues, support end users, and guide configuration decisions. 
 Identify opportunities to automate repetitive HR administrative and integration tasks using AI tools and HRIS workflow features (e.g., communications, data validation). 
 Build and maintain simple automations — using AI-assisted tools, Excel formulas/macros, or HRIS workflow builders — to reduce manual data entry and reporting effort. 
 HR & Administrative Support  
 Support in the development and implementation of Human Resources policies, procedures, and programs to improve employee experience across the Group's portfolio companies. 
 Support employees across the Group's portfolio companies on day-to-day HR questions — policies, leave, and general processes — escalating more complex matters as needed. 
 Provide general administrative support wherever priorities shift across the Group, including compliance, recruitment, onboarding & offboarding and ad hoc projects. 
 What You Bring:  
 College or Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field (equivalent experience considered). 
 2+ years of HR administration and coordination; experience with HRIS systems. 
 Demonstrated ability to adapt quickly to new, unfamiliar, or shifting situations — this role's mix of entities, jurisdictions, and priorities is always changing. 
 Comfort with, or strong interest in, HRIS systems (e.g. BambooHR) and general HR technology. 
 Genuine curiosity about and comfort using AI tools to support day-to-day productivity and process improvement. 
 Strong proficiency in the Microsoft Office environment, particularly Excel. 
 Technical background, with ability to learn and adapt new technologies & systems.  
 Excellent organizational skills and high attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple competing priorities across integration projects and daily HR support. 
 Continuous learning attitude and strong relationship-building skills. 
 Excellent written and verbal communication skills; good presentation skills. 
 Bilingualism (English/French). 
 Pluses:  
 Exposure to HR integrations in an M&A environment. 
 Experience in data analysis. 
 Experience with multi-country labor laws and compliance. 
 Why Is This Job Important?  
 As our HR Specialist you play a central role in how smoothly newly acquired businesses join Edelweiss Group, while also being available to support HR needs across the portfolio wherever they come up. Your adaptability keeps both integrations and day-to-day HR operations running smoothly even as priorities shift, and your curiosity about AI and automation helps the Group continuously work smarter. Your contributions directly impact employee experience and the overall success of Edelweiss Group. 
 For more information about Edelweiss Group, please reach out to your recruiting contact.

 veritree is an award-winning climate tech start-up based in Vancouver. Launched in 2021, our technology measures and verifies the impact of global restoration efforts from the ground up.  Every event earns its place. The full-year events program reports return on every event, and the 2028 calendar is shaped by results.
 A great team is in place. The marketing team is hired and performing against clear goals, working in rhythm with Content and Creative Services, Sales, and Customer Success.
 What You'll Do
 Product Marketing
 Own veritree's positioning, messaging, and ideal customer profile (ICP), and keep them current as the product and market evolve.
 Lead go-to-market planning for product launches and new offerings, from messaging through to sales readiness.
 Build and maintain sales enablement materials such as pitch decks, one-pagers, case studies, battlecards, and competitive analysis.

 Measure the impact of co-marketing on retention and expansion revenue.

Our clients range from startups and digital agencies to technology platforms in industries such as SaaS, MarTech, FinTech, and EdTech. Unlike traditional outsourcing agencies, we place you directly within a client’s team, where you’re hired in-house and become a valued member of their business.

 We’re seeking an experienced Account Executive / Sales Closer with a strong track record of converting qualified opportunities into successful deals.

 Essential experience in high-ticket sales and successfully closing deals.

About Faire 
 Faire is a technology wholesale platform built on the belief that the future is local. Independent retailers around the globe collectively represent a multi-hundred-billion-dollar wholesale market that has historically been fragmented and offline. At Faire, we're using the power of tech, data, and machine learning to connect this thriving community of entrepreneurs across the globe. Picture your favorite boutique in town — we help them discover the best products from around the world to sell in their stores. With the right tools and insights, we believe that we can level the playing field so businesses can grow and local communities can thrive.
 We’re looking for smart, resourceful and passionate people to join us as we power the shop local movement. If you believe in community, come join ours.
 About the role 
 Faire is building the future of wholesale, connecting independent retailers with the brands that will define their stores. At the heart of this mission is Compass — Faire’s user facing AI bet within the Discovery Pillar — building an always-present, context-aware retailer assistant along the enagement journey. Compass helps retailers make smarter buying decisions by combining Faire’s rich proprietary data with agentic AI and web search, and is increasingly able to take action on retailers’ behalf.
 As a Senior Applied AI/ML Scientist on the Compass team, you will be the science and technical lead for this product — driving agent quality through data, evaluation, and modeling, while shipping product features end-to-end with high velocity. This is a deeply hands-on individual contributor role: no direct reports, keyboard first. You will set the data-grounded direction for how the assistant works, while also being a full-stack (AI, ML, backend) builder who turns ideas into shipped product fast.
 You will work at the frontier of agentic AI, blending applied science rigor (eval-driven development, experimentation, data strategy) with cross-stack engineering range to build the retailer assistant of the future. This is a rare opportunity to shape a product from near-zero — where your judgment, speed, and instincts will define the outcomes.
 What you’ll do 
 Own the science and technical north star for Compass’s agentic products — the retailer assistant today and whatever comes next: how to leverage Faire’s proprietary data, agent + tool + context strategy (preload vs. tool-calling vs. hybrid), and how to measure and raise agent quality as systems gain the ability to act.
 Ship retailer-assistant features end-to-end — across the FLARE Python app, data plumbing, tool wrappers, and the frontend surfaces where the assistant appears, using AI-native workflows to multiply your output.
 Translate ambiguous product bets into sequenced, de-risked tactical plans — what to build now, what to defer, and which bets carry the highest impact × probability-of-success.
 Set and raise the bar for eval- and experiment-driven development — define how the team knows an agent is good, including offline eval suites, LLM-as-judge metrics, and quality criteria per surface and retailer journey.
 Make pragmatic engineering choices : simple enough to ship now, designed to evolve — not over-engineered for imagined future scale, but not throwaway either.
 Partner closely with engineers on architecture and serving tradeoffs, and act as the science/technical interface to adjacent teams (Search, Personalization, Platform/FLARE).
 Raise the team’s collective judgment through prototypes, analyses, design reviews, and pairing.
 You’re a great fit if you have… 
 5+ years of industry experience building and shipping production ML/AI systems with measurable business impact — including hands-on ownership of the applied-science side (data, evaluation, modeling, quality), not just system plumbing.
 Has shipped agentic / LLM-powered features in a core production product — with a deep, opinionated grasp of agent design tradeoffs: eval strategy, latency/cost/quality tension, tool-calling vs. context preload, guardrails, and failure containment.
 Strong applied ML / data science foundation — reasons from data, designs experiments and evals, and has turned proprietary or structured data into product capability.
 Track record of shipping fast across multiple stacks (backend, data, and ideally frontend) with quality — not a single-layer specialist; demonstrates cross-stack range.
 AI-native in practice: uses AI coding tools and agent workflows as a force multiplier in day-to-day work.
 Architectural maturity — can explain design choices that work simply today but won’t need to be thrown away when requirements grow.
 Operates with high autonomy and resourcefulness, with good judgment about when to escalate and when to just solve it.
 Fluent enough in engineering to make sound architecture calls.
 Bonus points for… 
 E-commerce, marketplace, or two-sided platform context — understanding of both sides of the retailer/brand dynamic.
 Experience evolving a read-only assistant into one that takes actions safely — confirm-first patterns, guardrails, and failure containment.
 Hands-on experience with the OpenAI Agents SDK or similar agentic frameworks in production.
 Familiarity with preload-over-RAG context strategies , Snowflake-backed grounding, or hybrid approaches.
 Prior 0→1 / early-stage product experience — has built something meaningful from scratch.
 Recommendation, retrieval, or personalization modeling background.
 Public writing, open-source contributions, or talks that show structured thinking about agentic / applied-AI systems.
 Salary Range 
 Canada: the pay range for this role is $180,000 to $247,500 per year.
 This role will also be eligible for equity and benefits. Actual base pay will be determined based on permissible factors such as transferable skills, work experience, market demands, and primary work location. The base pay range provided is subject to change and may be modified in the future.
 Faire uses Artificial Intelligence (AI) to screen and select applicants for this position.
 This job posting is for an existing vacancy.
 Hybrid Faire employees currently go into the office 3 days per week on Tuesdays, Thursdays, and a third flex day of their choosing (Monday, Wednesday, or Friday). Additionally, hybrid in-office roles will have the flexibility to work remotely up to 4 weeks per year. Specific Workplace and Information Technology positions may require onsite attendance 5 days per week as will be indicated in the job posting. 
 Why you’ll love working at Faire 
 Move fast: You'll own meaningful problems that serve customers around the globe with the agency to move fast and see your results clearly.
 Equipped to scale: We invest in what matters, including the latest enterprise AI tools, to help you work smarter and get more out of every day.
 Best in class: Our team is full of sharp, kind, and generous colleagues who care about their craft and about helping you grow in yours.
 Real rewards. Competitive pay, equity, and comprehensive benefits designed to support your life inside and outside of work.
 Belonging: We're intentional about building an environment where every Faire employee has equal access to opportunities, growth, and success.
 Faire was founded in 2017 by a team of early product and engineering leads from Square. We’re backed by some of the top investors in retail and tech including: Y Combinator, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Forerunner Ventures, Khosla Ventures, Sequoia Capital, Founders Fund, and DST Global. We have headquarters in San Francisco and Kitchener-Waterloo, and a global employee presence across offices in Toronto, London, and New York. To learn more about Faire and our customers, you can read more on our blog .
 Faire provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity or gender expression.
 Faire is committed to providing access, equal opportunity and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment, its services, programs, and activities. Accommodations are available throughout the recruitment process and applicants with a disability may request to be accommodated throughout the recruitment process. We will work with all applicants to accommodate their individual accessibility needs. To request reasonable accommodation, please fill out our Accommodation Request Form ( https://bit.ly/faire-form) 
 Privacy 
 For information about the type of personal data Faire collects from applicants, as well as your choices regarding the data collected about you, please visit Faire’s Privacy Notice (https://www.faire.com/privacy)

 The mission of the Technical Development Department is to deliver consistency and precision in the size, fit and construction of every style, and fulfill the creative vision.

 Aritzia is growing and our Technical Development team is growing with it. As the Senior Manager / Manager, Technical Development Management, you will support with optimizing and running the day-to-day operations of the Technical Development department. You will support with driving the integration of innovative technologies into the department, building, managing, and training the team on our systems to enable world-class product development.  Uphold and input world-class standards in our systems to guide development and specifications, delivering consistency and precision across our assortment 
 Build clear and comprehensive instructions, aligned to Aritzia’s standards, to enable accurate sample development 
 Manage and scale the execution of digital product creation (DPC) and physical sample requests 
 Effectively manage and optimize the day-to-day operations of technical development

 Proven and best-in-class skills, applicable certifications, education and/or experience in:  
 Gerber AccuMark 2D pattern design software  
 Browzwear 3D apparel design software  
 Centric – PLM software  
 A strong knowledge of sample measurement, construction, and execution evaluation   
 An understanding of garment fit and construction communication using sketches, imagery, and technical language

With comprehensive benefits, aspirational workspaces, and elevated perks and experiences — we provide it all.

 Product Discount — Maybe you’ve heard of our famous product discount? Or our exclusive private shopping events? You have now.   
 Baby Leave Program — We provide up to 16 weeks of paid time to support you and your growing family.

Contribuez à la réussite de projets hydroélectriques majeurs au Québec en dirigeant leur stratégie contractuelle de bout en bout. Au sein de l’équipe nord-américaine de gestion des contrats de GE Vernova Hydro Power, vous agirez comme partenaire commercial et contractuel des équipes de projet, de la soumission et de la négociation jusqu’à l’exécution, la clôture et la garantie. 
Vous gérerez les changements, écarts, réclamations, différends et enjeux d’assurance, tout en protégeant les intérêts commerciaux de GE Vernova et en maintenant des relations constructives avec les clients, partenaires, fournisseurs et sous-traitants.  Votre impact  
 Diriger la stratégie contractuelle de projets hydroélectriques au Québec pendant tout leur cycle de vie.  
 Protéger la position commerciale de GE Vernova grâce à une gestion rigoureuse des risques, changements, réclamations et obligations.  
 Aider les équipes de projet à prendre des décisions éclairées en traduisant les exigences contractuelles en actions concrètes.  
 Renforcer la conformité, la traçabilité et la discipline contractuelle dans un environnement matriciel complexe.

 Gestion contractuelle de bout en bout  
 Gérer les aspects contractuels des projets depuis la préparation des offres jusqu’à l’exécution, la clôture et la garantie.

 Préparer les avis, demandes de changement, réclamations et autres communications contractuelles dans les délais requis.  
 Veiller à ce que les équipes de projet comprennent et appliquent les obligations, droits et recours contractuels.  
 Stratégie, changements et gestion des risques  
 Analyser les contrats afin de repérer les risques, possibilités, écarts, hypothèses et points de vigilance.  
 Élaborer, maintenir et améliorer le plan de gestion contractuelle de chaque projet assigné.  
 Diriger les stratégies relatives aux changements, réclamations, différends, assurances et mesures d’atténuation en collaboration avec la direction de projet et l’équipe juridique.  
 Veiller à ce que les exigences pertinentes soient répercutées de façon appropriée dans les contrats des fournisseurs et sous-traitants.

 Collaborer étroitement avec la gestion de projet, le commercial, l’ingénierie, l’approvisionnement, la construction, la mise en service, les finances, le sourçage et les équipes juridiques.

Our partnerships with industry leaders like Palantir, NVIDIA, and OpenAI underscore our commitment to excellence. With over 200 successful projects and a team of ~200 professionals across Switzerland, Poland, Germany, Spain and the US, we have entered the Canadian market in early 2026 and are set for further expansion.
 Our mission
 Unit8 is dedicated to driving AI adoption in non-digital industries and accelerating their digital transformation. We invest in projects that matter, including pro-bono initiatives and “engineering for good” causes.
 The opportunity
 Following our growth in Europe and our recent expansion into the US market in early 2026, Unit8 is taking its next strategic step in North America. We are looking for an entrepreneurially minded Senior Data & AI Consultant / Consulting Lead to help expandestablish our Canadian presence in Montréal.
 This is, above all, a translator role. You are the person who sits with a client's leadership, understands what actually drives their business, and turns ambiguous problems into data & AI opportunities our engineers and data scientists can build. You are the bridge between the boardroom and the build, fluent enough in both to keep them aligned from first conversation to delivered value.
 You own the delivery and transformation strategy. You propose how to bring value across the full journey, from an initial idea and analysis through to large-scale transformation, and you are a strong communicator who can sell that plan and vision to C-level executives.
 As one of our first Canadian hires, you will help shape how the practice operates, which clients we pursue, and what Unit8 becomes known for in Canada.
 What you'll do
 Your role will evolve with our clients' needs and our growth in the region. In general, you will:
 Act as the bridge between business and technology, listening for the client's real pain points and framing them as data & AI opportunities that create measurable value
 Identify and prioritise the use cases across analytics, generative, and agentic AI that genuinely move the needle, from strategy through to implementation
 Build the business case for data & AI investments, quantifying ROI, costs, and benefits so client leaders can make confident decisions
 Shape data & AI strategies and pragmatic roadmaps that align with the client's broader business strategy and priorities
 Design the target operating models that determine how data & AI teams, functions, and centres of excellence work
 Support process re-engineering: rethinking how core business processes should work once data & AI is embedded, and helping clients manage the change
 Guide clients on their journey to becoming data- and AI-driven, assessing their maturity and keeping the work anchored to business outcomes
 Own the solution like a product manager, defining what “good” looks like, keeping scope honest, and holding the team accountable to the value delivered
 Team up with our data engineers, data scientists, AI engineers, and solution architects to turn use cases into working solutions, from modern data platforms and analytics products to machine learning and AI applications
 Contribute to business development by preparing for and taking part in client conversations, workshops, and industry conferences
 Support thought leadership through white papers and industry content on data science & AI
 Who you are
 Above all, you are a consultant and a translator: someone who can hold a business conversation with senior stakeholders and a technical conversation with engineers, and carry meaning cleanly between the two. Specifically, you are:
 A trained business consultant. You built your foundation in a leading management, strategy, or business consultancy (for example a Big 4 firm, Accenture, Capgemini, or a top strategy house), with at least 2 to 3 years of genuine business consulting project experience where you learned to structure ambiguity and drive to outcomes. This is typically part of a broader career of several years.

 Enterprise Underwriting Governance 
 Support and champion corporate underwriting philosophy, risk appetite, and underwriting governance standards.
 Provide enterprise oversight of underwriting practices across life, health, critical illness, disability, and medical reimbursement products.

 Assess and communicate the mortality and morbidity implications associated with underwriting and product design changes.
 Mortality and Morbidity Risk Management 
 Evaluate mortality and morbidity risks associated with existing and proposed products, underwriting methodologies, and distribution strategies.

 Product and Anti-Selection Risk Assessment

 Identify underwriting controls, medical requirements, and risk management measures necessary to mitigate adverse selection and fraud exposure.
 Provide risk guidance during new product development and product enhancement activities.
 Evaluate the potential impact of product design changes on underwriting outcomes and claims experience.

 Identify emerging fraud risks and vulnerabilities within underwriting and product frameworks.
 Recommend underwriting, medical, and operational controls designed to mitigate fraud exposure.

 High - Net - Worth and Complex Risk Expertise

 Monitor market developments and emerging risk trends impacting high-net-worth and Private Wealth business.

 Partner with reinsurance stakeholders as permitted to ensure alignment between underwriting strategies and risk transfer objectives.

En tant que société d’État à vocation financière, EDC propose des solutions financières innovantes et des conseils d’experts pour aider les entreprises à explorer de nouveaux marchés, à atténuer leurs risques et à se développer.
 Pourquoi vous joindre à EDC? 
 Gamme complète d’avantages sociaux : EDC offre un régime de rémunération et d’avantages sociaux concurrentiel, une bonne conciliation travail-vie personnelle et la chance de contribuer à bâtir un Canada et un monde meilleurs grâce au commerce.
 Conciliation travail-vie personnelle : EDC offre un régime concurrentiel en ce qui concerne la rémunération et la conciliation travail-vie personnelle : différentes options de travail hybride, trois à quatre semaines de vacances, une période de fermeture, des vendredis d’été raccourcis et les vendredis sans réunion.
 Perfectionnement professionnel : Profitez de nos occasions d’apprentissage continu, notamment des programmes de formation, des ateliers et de la formation linguistique.
 Culture inclusive : Intégrez un milieu de travail diversifié et inclusif qui lutte pour l’équité en matière d’emploi et valorise la diversité des idées, des forces et des origines pour favoriser la réussite.
 Programmes de bien-être : Nous offrons des initiatives de bien-être, de l’aide à la santé mentale et des programmes de conditionnement physique pour veiller à votre santé et à votre bonheur.
 Investissement dans la collectivité : Participez à des activités de bénévolat et donnez au suivant grâce à un éventail de programmes de responsabilité sociale.
 Aperçu de l’équipe : 
 L’Équipe de gestion du risque de modélisation assure la supervision, à l’échelle d’EDC, des risques associés aux modèles ainsi qu’aux autres outils utilisés à EDC. Elle établit et tient à jour les politiques de gouvernance, les normes, les procédures, les inventaires, les évaluations des risques et les rapports qui favorisent une gestion rigoureuse du cycle de vie des modèles. En outre, elle valide et examine de manière indépendante les modèles pour s’assurer qu’ils demeurent adaptés à l’usage auquel ils sont destinés. L’Équipe est également à la tête de programmes de gouvernance en évolution visant des outils non associés aux modèles et des modèles d’IA générative. Elle collabore avec les fonctions sectorielles, technologiques, de gestion des risques et de gouvernance pour établir des exigences pratiques et fondées sur les risques, conformes au mandat d’EDC et aux directives réglementaires applicables. 
 Ce que vous ferez : 
 La personne choisie dirigera une équipe de spécialistes du risque de modélisation et supervisera les activités indépendantes de validation, de gestion et de production des rapports liées aux modèles au sein d’EDC. Elle apportera un regard critique et pertinent sur le développement et l’utilisation des modèles, traduira les attentes réglementaires en contrôles concrets et conseillera les parties prenantes des échelons supérieurs sur le risque de modélisation, les limites et les priorités en matière de mesures correctives. Son leadership renforcera les pratiques d’EDC en matière de risque de modélisation et favorisera l’utilisation sûre et efficace des modèles et des technologies d’analyse émergentes. 
 Diriger, encadrer et former une équipe de spécialistes du risque de modélisation, établir les priorités et maintenir des normes élevées en matière de qualité des analyses, de documentation et de respect des délais. 
 Planifier et superviser des validations et des examens de modèles, de manière indépendante et selon une approche fondée sur le risque, dans l’ensemble des domaines de risque et d’activité concernés, notamment le risque de crédit, le risque financier, les prévisions, la tarification, l’évaluation, le capital, la simulation de crise et les analyses avancées. 
 Évaluer la conception des modèles, leur solidité conceptuelle, la qualité des données, la mise en œuvre, le rendement, les limites, les contrôles et la surveillance continue, et transmettre des conclusions et des recommandations claires. 
 Proposer des critiques constructives aux développeurs, propriétaires et utilisateurs de modèles, et superviser la détection, l’escalade hiérarchique et la correction rapide des anomalies révélées par les modèles et des acceptations du risque. 
 Assurer la mise à jour et l’amélioration des politiques, normes, procédures, inventaires, méthodologies de notation des risques et rapports de gestion relatifs au risque de modélisation, conformément à l’appétit pour le risque d’EDC et aux attentes réglementaires applicables. 
 Surveiller le profil de risque de modélisation et préparer des rapports concis ainsi que des recommandations à l’intention de la haute direction et des comités de gouvernance. 
 Conseiller les parties prenantes sur les exigences relatives au cycle de vie des modèles, les nouveaux cas d’utilisation des modèles, les modèles tiers, les risques liés à l’intelligence artificielle et à l’apprentissage automatique, ainsi que sur les approches de gouvernance proportionnelles. 
 Établir des relations fructueuses entre les équipes sectorielles et les fonctions de contrôle, et apporter son soutien aux contrôles réglementaires, aux vérifications internes et aux autres activités d’assurance liées au risque de modélisation. 
 Promouvoir l’amélioration continue grâce à des méthodes, des outils, des données, une automatisation et un partage des connaissances plus efficaces tout en préservant l’indépendance de la fonction de gestion du risque de modélisation. 
 Ce que nous cherchons: 
 Diplôme de premier cycle dans une discipline quantitative comme la statistique, les mathématiques, l’économie, les finances, l’actuariat, l’informatique, l’ingénierie ou un domaine connexe, ou combinaison équivalente d’études et d’expérience 
 Au moins 7 années d’expérience progressive en gestion du risque de modélisation, en validation des modèles, en élaboration de modèles, en gestion des risques quantitatifs ou dans un domaine étroitement lié au sein d’une institution financière ou d’un environnement réglementé 
 Expérience avérée en matière de gestion d’équipes, de projets complexes ou d’un portefeuille d’examens simultanés de modèles, tout en assumant la responsabilité de la qualité, du respect des délais et des résultats attendus par les parties prenantes 
 Solide connaissance de la gouvernance du risque de modélisation et du cycle de vie des modèles, notamment la reconnaissance des modèles, la notation des risques, la validation, l’approbation, la mise en œuvre, le suivi, la gestion des changements et la mise hors service 
 Solides connaissances en analyse quantitative et en statistique; capacité à évaluer les méthodologies, les hypothèses, les données, la mise en œuvre et le rendement des modèles pour tout un éventail de types de modèles 
 Maîtrise des attentes réglementaires du secteur financier canadien et des pratiques du secteur en matière de gestion du risque de modélisation, notamment la Ligne directrice E-23 du Bureau du surintendant des institutions financières (BSIF) et les considérations connexes relatives à la gouvernance, aux données et aux risques technologiques 
 Excellent jugement, bon esprit critique et solides compétences en communication écrite et orale, et capacité à expliquer des questions techniques complexes et à convaincre les parties prenantes des échelons supérieurs 
 Capacité à établir des relations fructueuses tout en conservant son indépendance, son objectivité et son esprit critique 
 Excellentes compétences en communication écrite et orale en français et en anglais 
 Ce qui vous distinguera : 
 Diplôme d’études supérieures dans une discipline quantitative ou commerciale 
 Titre professionnel (p. ex. CFA, FRM, PRM ou CPA) ou titre d’actuaire 
 Expérience dans le domaine des modèles de risque de crédit, notamment la probabilité de défaut, la perte en cas de défaut et l’exposition en cas de défaut; maîtrise du modèle de pertes de crédit attendues (IFRS 9), de la simulation de crise, du capital économique, de l’évaluation, des prévisions ou des modèles de tarification 
 Expérience dans l’évaluation de l’intelligence artificielle, de l’apprentissage automatique, de l’IA générative ou de modèles tiers, ainsi que des risques associés en matière d’explicabilité, d’équité, de données, de rendement et de gouvernance 
 Maîtrise pratique des outils d’analyse ou des langages de programmation comme Python, R, SAS, SQL ou des technologies comparables 
 Expérience dans l’amélioration des cadres de gouvernance des modèles, la mise en œuvre de changements réglementaires ou la conduite de transformations en matière de processus, de données ou de technologies au sein d’une fonction de gestion du risque de modélisation 
 Connaissances dans les domaines du crédit à l’exportation, des prêts commerciaux, de l’assurance, du financement du commerce ou de l’environnement commercial d’EDC 
 Admissibilité : 
 EDC s'engage à respecter des pratiques d'emploi équitables et la préférence sera accordée aux candidats qui sont en mesure de travailler légalement au Canada au moment de la présentation de leur candidature (citoyens canadiens ou résidents permanents). Les candidats doivent satisfaire aux exigences de sécurité du gouvernement. Pour obtenir de plus amples renseignements, veuillez consulter la section 2.1 de la Norme d’acquisition des talents, accessible sur LINK sous l’onglet Ressources, dans la section Politiques et procédures. Le poste est ouvert aux personnes qui répondent à toutes les exigences essentielles énoncées ci-dessus et dont la candidature est reçue avant la date limite. 
 Engagement d’EDC envers l’équité en matière d’emploi 
 Exportation et développement Canada (EDC) s’engage à favoriser l’équité en matière d’emploi et à constituer une main-d’œuvre diversifiée. Elle s’engage à créer un environnement sûr et inclusif qui respecte les personnes de toutes les origines, aptitudes et compétences. EDC favorise une culture d’inclusion et d’appartenance où chaque personne a des chances égales de se perfectionner, de se développer, de réussir et de réaliser son plein potentiel. 
 Votre candidature doit démontrer clairement que vous répondez à toutes les exigences. Nous remercions tous les candidats de l'intérêt qu'ils portent à une carrière à EDC. Toutefois, seules les personnes sélectionnées pour un entretien seront contactées. Veuillez noter que les candidats qualifiés peuvent être pris en considération pour des postes similaires à ce niveau au sein d'EDC.
 EDC reconnaît que le fait de divulguer la nécessité de prévoir des mesures d’adaptation peut être une question personnelle. Sachez qu’en tant qu’organisation, nous nous engageons à respecter la confidentialité et à veiller à ce que toutes les mesures d’adaptation fournies soient adaptées à vos besoins. Notre objectif est de vous garantir une expérience positive et satisfaisante tout au long du processus de recrutement. N’hésitez donc pas à nous contacter directement pour toute demande d’adaptation à l’adresse accessibility@edc.ca . Nous sommes là pour vous aider à chaque étape du processus.
 Énoncé de confidentialité 
 En postulant à cet emploi, vous reconnaissez avoir lu et compris l'Énoncé de confidentialité d’EDC pour les candidats à l’emploi , qui décrit comment nous recueillons, utilisons, conservons et protégeons les renseignements personnels pendant le processus de recrutement, ainsi que vos droits d’accès et de rectification.

Senior Data Quality Engineer - Zonda - Toronto, Ontario 
 Job Description
 Company Overview: 
 CoStar Group (NASDAQ: CSGP) is a leading global provider of commercial and residential real estate information, analytics, and online marketplaces. Included in the S&P 500 Index, CoStar Group is on a mission to digitize the world’s real estate, empowering all people to discover properties, insights and connections that improve their businesses and lives.
 We have been living and breathing the world of real estate information and online marketplaces for over 35 years, giving us the perspective to create truly unique and valuable offerings to our customers. We’ve continually refined, transformed, and perfected our approach to our business, creating a language that has become standard in our industry, for our customers, and even our competitors. We continue that effort today and are always working to improve and drive innovation. This is how we deliver for our customers, our employees, and investors. By equipping the brightest minds with the best resources available, we provide an invaluable edge in real estate.
 About Zonda: 
 Zonda is redefining the future of housing. We are perfectly placed in the heart of the fast-growing real estate industry. We are making big bets on the future of real-estate, trailblazing a 2030 vision for the industry. Here at Zonda, you’ll be able to use your passion and curiosity to drive the next generation of real estate analysts, advisors, technologists, and marketers.
 Learn more about Zonda 
 We are looking for a Senior Data Quality Engineer to build and operate the testing and validation capabilities that ensure data delivered through our enterprise data platform is accurate, complete, consistent, and fit for business use.
 Our environment includes Snowflake, AWS Aurora/RDS, Amazon MWAA/Apache Airflow, dbt, AWS Glue, Amazon S3, DataHub, Grafana, and CloudWatch .
 This is a hands-on senior engineering role focused on end-to-end data pipeline testing, automated validation, regression testing, test-data management, and business-rule verification .
 A major part of the role is partnering with Product, Research, Advisory, Economics, Data Engineering, and other business subject-matter experts to translate business definitions, methodologies, and expected outcomes into measurable and repeatable tests.
 Data Engineers remain responsible for testing the pipelines and transformations they build. The Senior Data Quality Engineer provides reusable testing frameworks, curated test data, broader regression coverage, and independent validation for critical or higher-risk changes .
 This position will be located in Toronto, Ontario and is in office Monday through Friday. 
 Responsibilities: 
 Data Pipeline & Regression Testing 
 Design and execute testing strategies for ETL/ELT pipelines, transformations, integrations, and published data products.
 Validate data end to end, from source ingestion through transformation and final output.
 Perform source-to-target reconciliation to validate completeness, accuracy, mappings, calculations, aggregations, joins, filters, and business rules.
 Build regression coverage to detect unintended changes caused by pipeline, schema, transformation, or business-rule updates.
 Test large datasets using appropriate sampling, aggregate reconciliation, full-population comparisons, and targeted edge cases.
 Validate nulls, duplicates, referential integrity, incremental processing, historical behavior, distributions, and other material data conditions.
 Business-Driven Test Design 
 Work with business and domain experts to understand how critical data is expected to behave.
 Translate agreed business definitions, methodologies, calculations, and acceptance criteria into executable test scenarios.
 Identify business-critical attributes, expected outcomes, edge cases, and quality thresholds.
 Validate whether outputs conform to agreed business expectations, not simply whether pipelines execute successfully.
 Maintain traceability between requirements, test cases, defects, and release-validation evidence.
 Test Data Management 
 Create and maintain curated test datasets and expected results representing common scenarios, edge cases, historical conditions, and known failure modes.
 Work with business SMEs and Data Engineers to identify representative records and expected outcomes.
 Use synthetic, masked, controlled, or approved production-derived data as appropriate to maintain safe test-data practices.
 Maintain reusable baseline datasets as source data, schemas, methodologies, and business rules evolve.
 Automation & Quality Frameworks 
 Develop reusable automated validation frameworks using SQL, Python, dbt, and other appropriate technologies .
 Automate checks for freshness, volume, completeness, uniqueness, validity, referential integrity, business rules, reconciliation, distribution, and drift.
 Build standardized testing patterns reusable across data products and pipelines.
 Partner with Data Platform Engineering to integrate quality checks into CI/CD, dbt, Airflow/MWAA, and release workflows .
 Enable critical validation failures to prevent downstream execution or publication where agreed quality thresholds are not met.
 Release Validation & Monitoring 
 Maintain risk-based regression suites for critical data products and pipelines.
 Independently validate material or higher-risk data releases before production publication.
 Compare candidate outputs against approved baselines or production results to identify unexpected differences.
 Provide objective quality evidence, identified risks, and release-readiness recommendations; business and product owners retain responsibility for business acceptance and publication decisions.
 Perform post-release validation for critical changes.
 Establish ongoing monitoring for key data-quality indicators and partner with Data Platform Engineering to surface actionable alerts through Grafana, CloudWatch, DataHub, or related capabilities.
 Investigate quality failures with Data Engineers and convert recurring defects into automated regression tests or preventative controls.
 Quality Standards & Enablement 
 Establish reusable data-testing standards, methodologies, templates, and best practices.
 Define expectations for test planning, evidence, defect documentation, and risk-based validation.
 Help Data Engineers apply appropriate project-level testing while providing independent validation where additional assurance is warranted.
 Mentor engineering teams on reconciliation, test-data design, regression testing, and data-quality engineering practices.
 Continuously improve test coverage and automation based on business impact and risk.
 Basic Qualifications: 
 6+ years of experience in Data Quality Engineering, Data Testing, Quality Engineering, Data Engineering, or a related discipline, including significant experience testing production data systems.
 Strong hands-on experience with ETL/ELT and end-to-end data pipeline testing .
 Strong experience with source-to-target reconciliation, regression testing, and large-dataset validation .
 Advanced SQL skills for data analysis, reconciliation, comparison, and validation.
 Strong scripting or test-automation skills, preferably Python .
 Experience designing automated data-testing or data-quality frameworks.
 Experience creating test cases, expected results, and curated test datasets for complex data scenarios.
 Experience validating data in modern cloud data platforms ; Snowflake experience is preferred.
 Experience testing pipelines built with technologies such as dbt, Apache Airflow, AWS Glue, or comparable ETL/ELT frameworks .
 Strong understanding of data-quality dimensions including accuracy, completeness, consistency, uniqueness, validity, freshness, referential integrity, and distribution.
 Experience with defect analysis, release validation, and root-cause investigation.
 Ability to work directly with business SMEs to translate complex domain requirements into measurable test scenarios.
 Strong analytical and communication skills, including the ability to explain quality findings and risks to both technical and business audiences.
 Preferred Qualifications: 
 Experience with several of the following would be valuable:
 dbt testing and custom tests
 Amazon MWAA / Apache Airflow
 AWS Glue and S3
 DataHub or similar metadata/catalog platforms
 Data profiling, anomaly detection, and statistical or distribution-based validation
 Data-quality scorecards and quality KPIs
 CI/CD integration for automated data testing
 Large-scale or high-volume data validation
 Experience with analytical, research, economic, financial, real-estate, or other complex domain datasets
 You do not need to be an expert in every technology in our environment. We are looking for strong data-testing fundamentals, analytical depth, automation capability, and the ability to understand both the technical and business meaning of data .
 Success means creating a data-quality capability where:
 Critical data sets have documented, repeatable, and risk-appropriate test coverage.
 Business definitions and expected outcomes are translated into measurable tests.
 Reusable test data and expected results cover critical scenarios and edge cases.
 Data pipelines are validated from source through published output.
 Regression and reconciliation tests identify unintended changes before publication.
 Critical quality failures prevent incorrect data from reaching downstream products.
 Recurring production issues become automated regression coverage.
 Data Engineers can use shared testing capabilities across projects.
 Business teams have greater confidence that published data reflects agreed definitions, methodologies and expected outcomes.
 What's in it for you? 
 When you join CoStar Group, you’ll experience a collaborative and innovative culture working alongside the best and brightest to empower our people and customers to succeed.
 We offer you generous compensation and performance-based incentives. CoStar Group also invests in your professional and academic growth with internal training and tuition reimbursement.
 Our benefits package includes (but is not limited to):
 Comprehensive healthcare coverage: Medical / Vision / Dental / Prescription Drug
 Life, legal, and supplementary insurance
 Virtual and in person mental health counseling services for individuals and family
 Commuter and parking benefits
 401(K) retirement plan with matching contributions
 Employee stock purchase plan
